title: Ali Siddiq: The Domino Effect 3: First Day of School
overview: The next chapter in Ali Siddiq's comedy special series, The Domino Effect.  This 75-minute special tells the true stories of Ali Siddiq’s first few years of incarceration for drug trafficking. The Domino Effect 1 & 2 have over 16 million views combined and are available on his YouTube page.
